checks: Angular loads six products and the published bridge emits actual NgRx actions
Cart scene has reorder, nested gift wrap, integer totals, discount and quantity changes
Real extension transport and action list receive the application actions
Quantity changes appear in the extension Diff tab
Stable cart-line IDs let the actual extension show a move instead of replacements
Rich diff shows additions, removals, moves, quantity, nested options and totals in one action
Repeating the scene produces exactly the same business state
Successful order stores ORD-1048 and clears the bag
Failed payment keeps all items and creates no order
Retry after simulated failure completes an actual order
Manual controls dispatch the same actions
Invalid promo emits a failure action without changing totals
Valid promo is trimmed and normalized
Removing the last product clears its coupon
